turkey.visa: E-visa available online for most nationalities; valid for 90 days.
turkey.weather_overview: Mediterranean climate on the coasts, continental inland; hot dry summers, mild wet winters.

japan.visa: Visa-free for many nationalities for stays up to 90 days.
japan.weather_overview: Four distinct seasons; humid summers, cold winters with snow in the north.

france.visa: Schengen visa required for many non-EU nationalities; visa-free for EU/Schengen members.
france.weather_overview: Temperate climate; mild winters and warm summers.

egypt.visa: E-visa or visa on arrival available for most nationalities.
egypt.weather_overview: Desert climate; very hot summers, mild winters.

brazil.visa: Visa-free for many nationalities for short stays; check current requirements.
brazil.weather_overview: Tropical climate; hot and humid, with a distinct rainy season.

india.visa: E-visa available online for most nationalities.
india.weather_overview: Varied climate; hot summers, monsoon season, mild winters.
